actions.q: Who owns the money in a Trump Account?

fact_basis.fact: IRS: account is 'a new type of individual retirement account' for a child, established by 'parents, guardians and other authorized individuals'; the publication says it is 'for the exclusive benefit of certain children'
Page: locked until Jan 1 of the year the child turns 18; kids savings account is often joint/custodial with a parent as co-owner
fact_basis.source: page FAQ 'Who owns a kids savings account'
